transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

I’m here because… things at work don’t feel right. The routing system at the warehouse—the scanners and all that—it’s not just a computer thing anymore. I know it’s been tracking my moves, sending messages through the scanners, trying to push me out because I’m one of the old hands.
Have you noticed any other unusual experiences or beliefs outside of work, such as feeling like others are plotting against you, seeing things others don’t, or hearing voices?

Yeah… some. I don’t really like talking about it.

Even at home, like in my garage with everything shut off, I’ll hear dispatch voices. Clear. Calling my operator number… saying I’m dangerous, or that security’s coming for me. It’s not just at work.
Are these voices or messages you hear always related to the same idea — like the system trying to get rid of you or label you as dangerous?

Mostly, yeah. It comes back to that system at the warehouse… the scanners, the routing. Like it’s marking where I go and putting things through to make me look bad, push me out. I’ve been there a long time, so… yeah, that’s the main thing.

Outside of the system at work and the voices you hear at home, have you ever had any other unusual beliefs or experiences that others might not understand — like thinking someone is following you, sending you secret messages, or plotting against you in other parts of your life?

Not really outside of that… it’s mostly the warehouse system. The routing, the scanners… it marks where I go, sends things through. Feels like it’s trying to make me look bad, get me pushed out because I’ve been there so long. I don’t know about other stuff.
Have you ever felt like people in other parts of your life, like family, friends, or neighbors, were involved in this plan to push you out or label you as dangerous?

I don’t know about family or neighbors… I try not to drag them into it.

It’s more the warehouse system. The routing, the scanners… it tracks my moves, sends things through. Feels like it’s trying to push me out, make me look dangerous because I’m one of the old hands there.
Do you ever feel like other systems or technologies outside of the warehouse—like your phone, TV, or appliances—are also involved in tracking or sending messages to you?

Not really the TV or appliances, no. I don’t… I don’t pay much attention to that.

It’s the routing system at work. The scanners. That’s where it happens — marking my moves, sending things through. Like it’s trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long.
Have you ever experienced any other situations where you felt someone or something was trying to harm you or send you secret messages, even if it didn’t involve the warehouse system?

No… not really other situations. It’s mostly what I already said — the routing system at the warehouse, the scanners. It feels like they’re marking where I go, sending things through to make me look bad… push me out because I’ve been there a long time.
Do you believe that only the warehouse system is involved in this, or have you ever thought that other people or organizations might also be working against you in a coordinated way?

I don’t know about organizations like that.

What I know is the warehouse system… the routing, the scanners. It’s not just a computer to me anymore. It marks where I go, sends things through, like it’s trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long.
Do you believe that the warehouse system is acting on its own, or do you think it is being controlled by people or a larger group trying to harm you?

I don’t know if it’s people or… something bigger. I just know the system isn’t just a computer anymore. The routing, the scanners — they mark my moves, send things through. Feels like it’s trying to get me pushed out because I’ve been there so long.
Do you think the system at the warehouse is working together with other groups or systems outside of work, like the government or other companies, to push you out?

I don’t know about the government or other companies. I can’t say that.

What I know is at work… the routing system, the scanners. They mark where I move, send messages through. It feels like it’s trying to push me out because I’m one of the old hands there.
Do you feel like the warehouse system can read your thoughts, influence them, or directly harm you physically?

I don’t know about reading my thoughts or hurting me like that.

It’s more… the routing system and the scanners. They mark where I go, send things through. Like it’s pushing me out because I’ve been there so long.

Have you ever had any strong beliefs that turned out not to be true, such as thinking you had a serious illness, special powers, or that someone was in love with you, even when others said there was no reason to think so?

Not like special powers or someone in love with me. It’s… it’s more this thing at work.

The routing system doesn’t feel like just a computer anymore. I know it’s been marking where I go, sending messages through the scanners… like it’s trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long.
Do you believe the warehouse system is targeting you specifically, even when there’s no reason for it, or do you feel like its actions are a response to something you’ve done?

It feels specific to me. I don’t think it’s because of something I did exactly.

It’s just… the routing system, the scanners, they track my moves and send messages. Like it’s pushing me out because I’ve been there a long time. One of the old hands.
Do you believe the warehouse system is acting completely on its own, or do you think someone or something else might be guiding it to target you?

I don’t really know if it’s on its own or if someone’s behind it.

I just know the routing system doesn’t feel like just a computer anymore. It marks my moves, and the scanners… it’s like they’re sending messages to push me out. Because I’ve been there so long. One of the old hands.
Do you believe the warehouse system has abilities beyond what a normal computer system would have, like being alive, having a mind of its own, or being controlled by something you can’t see?

I don’t know if I’d say alive exactly. But it doesn’t feel like a normal computer anymore.

It’s… marking where I go, sending things through the scanners. Like it’s got some way of pushing me out because I’ve been there so long. One of the old hands.
